title: STNFS with a ball-region sieved descent: 2^122.138

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 (modelled 0.4206, directed-rounding bound 0.4203, proof.md section 7) under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.138 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.137768. Relation collection keeps the accepted frontier's 2601/2500 work and 2401/2500 yield brackets; its f-side ECM cofactor slack is 291 bits (surviving f-side cofactors bounded by 299) and its g-side slack is 222 bits (surviving g-side cofactors bounded by 230), with the per-survivor two-side ECM charged by the package's explicit ecm16.py schedule at 99% per prime (2^37.5177 and 2^37.5150 per side, 2^38.5165 per survivor including the norm and trial-division charges). Retained yield is 2^64.224, which is 0.394 bits above 1.3 U and above the model's 0.30-bit feasibility floor. The descent's missing-log input is LOG2_RELS = 64.224 = floor(pool estimate 2^64.2243), the same input and the same rule as the accepted 122.2065 frontier; evidence16.py sets this value and checks LOG2_RELS <= log2_rels (the rels_input check). The one-standard-error input proposed by 8a407ed6 is not used. The boot keeps 8 relations instead of 16, so its charged failure probability is psi^8 = 1.5088e-02 with psi = 0.59201 (charged twice, once per boot); with the same 62-node plan the two-log expectation is 2^117.843 units and the metered cap is 2^118.732 units, above it (Markov abort <= 2^-0.888, exact 2^-0.8885). The modelled success 0.4206 keeps a 0.030 margin over the 0.39 floor, which absorbs a 1.92x increase in the boot failure term, a 5.8% increase in the modelled two-log expectation, or a 2x error in any single small term. Relation collection is 2^121.7399 units at 398.5 instructions per cell; the record path is charged at the package's own measured argument h = 2 cells/p (measurements12.txt section B), log2h = log2(2S) - lp, guarded by evidence16.py check [5b]; the line/record split is retuned to P_MID = 21, so the new [2^20, 2^21) octave is charged at the measured line-table minimum 24.10 instructions per hit (its production line-coset size is at least 2^33 cells, above the measured table top 2^13.82). The certified norm-bound per-block charge is the measured marginal 1,508.2 instructions (measurements12.txt); linear algebra uses block sizes (26,5), per-entry charges 88/97 (the package's 88-instruction component sum and the measured 97-instruction bw_full loop), and the filtering/LA pad 1.61, whose charged ratio 1.61 x 0.0471 = 0.07585 still exceeds the worst measured 2^12 filtering seed ratio 0.0757. Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.138 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool, ledger, filtering, descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger and modelled_success.
